FOR  THE OFFENCE P/US/ 498-A,304-B,504,323,109 R/W SEC.34 OF IPC  AND SEC.3,4 AND 6 OF DP ACT.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER  WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  -2-  NC: 2024:KHC:32127  CRL.P No. 7482 of 2024  ORAL ORDER 1.

Accused no.1 in S.C.No.114/2024 pending before the Court of IV Addl. District & Sessions Judge,
Hassan, sitting at Channarayapatna, arising out of Crime No.18/2024 registered by Shravanabelagola Police Station, Hassan District, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A,
304B, 504, 323, 109 read with 34 IPC and Sections 3, 4 & 6 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, is before this Court under Section 439 Cr.PC.
2. Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.
3. FIR in Crime No.18/2024 was registered by Shravanabelagola Police Station, Hassan District,
against the petitioner herein and five others for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 304B,
504, 34 IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, on the basis of the first information dated 22.02.2024 received from Shekara - father of deceased Surabhi.

sentences.text: During the course of investigation, petitioner herein was arrested on 23.02.2024 and remanded to judicial custody.
Bail application filed by him before the jurisdictional Sessions Court in S.C.No.114/2021 was rejected on 04.06.2024.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
Learned Counsel for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition, has prayed to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.
6. The material on record would go to show that the marriage of deceased Surabhi with the petitioner herein was solemnized on 25.04.2021.
In the first information as well as in the charge sheet, it is alleged that at the time of marriage, family of the victim had given dowry to petitioner no.1 as per their demand.
In the first information, it is alleged that accused no.1 had illicit relationship with accused no.5, and accused no.5 was pestering the deceased to give divorce to accused no.1.

sentences.text:
In the charge sheet, it is alleged that on 22.02.2024 after deceased came to know that accused no.1 and accused no.5 had gone together to Srirangapatna and were staying together privately,
deceased had committed suicide in her matrimonial home by hanging herself to a ceiling fan with the help of her saree.

Considering the aforesaid allegations found in the charge sheet and also having regard to the fact that investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been already filed, I am of the opinion that the petitioner who is in custody from 23.02.2024 has made out a prima facie case for grant of regular bail.

Accordingly, the following order:
8. The petition is allowed.
